title: Critique: physics may be structure or dispositions all the way down

statements.text: Structuralism about physics can be accepted without realism about quiddities. On respected structuralist or dispositionalist views, physics involves only structure or dispositions all the way down, with no categorical ground. Russellian monists reply that such views seem to leave a world without substance or qualities.

sources.quote: There are respectable structuralist or dispostionalist views of physics on which physics involves just structure or dispositions all the way down
